free_tier_limits: No hosted free tier or free low-volume API key; self-hosting remains free.
rate_limits: Hosted Pro: bursts up to 80 translations/minute; Business: bursts up to 200 translations/minute. Higher custom request/minute or character limits are available from support.
resolution_notes: free_tier=false and free_tier_limits: the official portal says there is no free trial or free low-volume API key; users may self-host instead (https://portal.libretranslate.com/). rate_limits: the portal publishes Pro at 80 and Business at 200 translations/minute, with custom higher limits available (https://portal.libretranslate.com/). cors=yes: current official source adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and permits GET and POST (https://github.com/LibreTranslate/LibreTranslate/blob/main/libretranslate/app.py).
